title: When Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) Coverage and Limit Changes Take Effect
content:
## Clauses in force

1. When the excess policy is bound together with a new underlying primary policy, it takes effect on the underlying policy's effective date with the tier's concurrent-purchase waiting period, but never before that underlying date.
2. A limit decrease takes effect on the date the signed request is received.
3. A loss that begins before coverage or an increase takes effect is not covered by it.

## Retired clause

> An Excess Flood policy, and a mid-term limit increase, takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day the tier's standard waiting period in calendar days after the signed application (or endorsement request) and full payment are received.

This clause is **no longer in force** as written. It is superseded by the current basis: for a to-value limit increase, the date the increase takes effect is set by the current basis for such increases; a new policy, and every other change, takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day the tier's standard waiting period in calendar days after the signed application or endorsement request and full payment are received.

## How the waiting period counts (hypothetical dates)

The clock starts on the day the later of the signed application (or endorsement request) and full payment is received; the coverage attaches at 12:01 a.m. on the day the tier's standard waiting period in calendar days after that day. With a 30-day waiting period and both received on 3 March, a new policy takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on 2 April; a flood beginning on 1 April is not covered by it.

| Change | Takes effect |
|---|---|
| New policy, standing alone | 12:01 a.m. on the day the standard waiting period after the signed application and full payment |
| New policy bound with a new underlying policy | the underlying effective date, never before it |
| Limit decrease | the date the signed request is received |

superseded_clauses: An Excess Flood policy, and a mid-term limit increase, takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day standard_waiting_days calendar days after the signed application (or endorsement request) and full payment are received.
